title: More ways to build with Pollinations
summary:
Community projects filled out the directory while the image feed and text API gained more useful context.

The project list grew across the week with chat interfaces, interactive stories, image tools, social bots, and video-making tools. New listings included IRINA, MoneyPrinterTurbo, Imagemate AI, Anisurge, and AI Chat for Windows.

AI-assisted coding and website-building projects gained a Vibe Coding ✨ category. Featured-project ordering was tidied up, duplicate listings were removed, and missing categories and project names were corrected.

Ads triggered by `p-ads` can include a generated 120×120 image. Their short copy now uses the current response and recent conversation for context, rather than translating existing ad text.

Authenticated image-feed listeners can receive the full event stream, including saved events replayed on connection; other listeners retain the existing filters. Browser clients can also inspect non-OK text-cache responses across origins instead of having the errors hidden by CORS checks.
